title: Catastrophic Share of Income for a Patient Financial Assistance Program Renewal, by Documented Percent and Coverage
content:
**Rule.** For a renewal application under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, the catastrophic share used for the catastrophic threshold depends on the household's documented percent of the poverty guideline on the award being renewed and on its coverage in Insurance Coverage & Claims:

- a household documented above 300 percent with an active coverage on file uses a share of 12.5 percent;
- a household documented at or below 200 percent with no active coverage on file uses a share of 7.5 percent;
- for any other household this rule does not change the share.

The catastrophic threshold is the share, as a percent, of the documented annual household income on the award being renewed, rounded to the cent.

## Truth table

| Documented percent | Active coverage on file in Insurance Coverage & Claims | Share under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| Above 300 | Yes | 12.5 percent |
| Above 300 | No | Not changed |
| Above 200, at most 300 | Yes or no | Not changed |
| At or below 200 | No | 7.5 percent |
| At or below 200 | Yes | Not changed |

"Active coverage on file" means at least one coverage of the household in active status; a coverage pending verification, inactive or terminated is not active.

## Boundary readings

- Documented at exactly 300.0 percent is not above 300; documented at 300.1 percent is.
- Documented at exactly 200.0 percent is at or below 200.

## Worked thresholds (hypothetical households)

- Documented income $52000.00, documented percent 320.5, an active commercial coverage on file: 12.5 percent of $52000.00 gives a threshold of $6500.00.
- Documented income $18000.00, documented percent 115.0, no active coverage on file: 7.5 percent of $18000.00 gives a threshold of $1350.00.
